[Source](../../../../src/runtime/online-presence.ts)

Opt-in PC/VR/AR lobby and lightweight remote poses. Each participant explicitly
maps their local floor to the party frame; this is presence, not shared physics.

- `three`
- `../math/geo/sphere.js`
- `./online.js`
- `./xr.js`
- `./xr-panel-canvas.js`
